stepTitle: Consolidate duplicated menu assembly around F5
acceptanceCriteria: 1. Remaining duplicated menu assembly paths are replaced by a shared builder contract. 2. Public, preview, and editor/publishing consumers preserve existing response semantics. 3. Targeted API tests and any directly affected consumer tests pass. 4. Relevant maintainer docs are updated if route or builder behavior documentation changes.

findings.summary: WhatsApp get-menu tool duplicates menu assembly instead of using shared buildMenu()
findings.detail: This file queries menuCategories (active) and menuItems (available) directly, groups items by categoryId, and maps to a response shape — the exact same assembly logic as buildMenu() with mode 'public' minus locale/translation handling. AC1 requires all duplicated menu assembly paths to go through the shared builder. The WhatsApp tool should call buildMenu({ mode: 'public', ... }) or a new simplified mode and project the result to its simpler shape, rather than reimplementing the query+grouping. The FINAL-CONSOLIDATED-REPORT.md F5 closure section does not mention this consumer at all.
